title: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia: card flavor text

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A former ruler of Mirrodin whose reign is recalled by the myr-like Memnites.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane contested between its native peoples and the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: Leonin kha who rules from Taj-Nar, destined leader of the leonin prides.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin that gives up treasure at a deadly price.

entities.name: Great Furnace
entities.description: A furnace stoked by the Kuldotha Forgemaster, known to goblins.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: A Neurok agent who values tireless allies against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders seeking to corrupt Mirrodin into their vision of perfection.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A spellcaster who mused on teleportation to oblivion.

entities.name: Varil
entities.description: A Neurok partisan fighting the Phyrexians' mindless armies.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: A human people of Mirrodin with agents and partisans resisting Phyrexia.

entities.name: Bladehold
entities.description: An Auriok stronghold housing a gallery of living 'statues' of their worst enemies.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: A human people of Mirrodin associated with Bladehold.

entities.name: Battle of Liet Field
entities.description: A carnage-filled battle after which the white sun crested above Taj-Nar.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: Throne of Raksha Golden Cub.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Site of the Knowledge Pool and source of vedalken arcana.

entities.name: Knowledge Pool
entities.description: A site located in Lumengrid.

entities.name: Adaran
entities.description: A Tangle hunter who fought a Fume Spitter.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian realm and vision, described as eternal and wasting nothing.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: A speaker exclaiming about eating meat and eggs.

entities.name: Sitrik
entities.description: A birth priest who calls death an outmoded concept.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: A Phyrexian who glorifies Yawgmoth through death.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The figure whom deaths glorify, according to Tsabo Tavoc.

entities.name: Ezoc
entities.description: A Golgari rot farmer who speeds the rotting of matter.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A faction whose rot farmer Ezoc speaks of decay.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Keeper and Lord of the Vault who speaks of conquest and Mirrodin kneeling for perfection.

events.summary: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to survivors.
events.quote: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

relations.quote: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.
"Anything that watches without sleep and fights without fear is a valuable ally against the Phyrexians."
Bladehold houses a rogues' gallery filled with the living "statues" of the worst enemies of the Auriok.
Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.
"Your life was meaningless, but your death will glorify Yawgmoth."
Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin
